question: Sutured Ghoul and Runeclaw Bear enter the battlefield from my graveyard at the same time. Can I exile either of them with Sutured Ghoul's replacement effect?

expected.shortAnswer: No: you can't choose to exile either of them when applying Sutured Ghoul's replacement effect.
expected.answer: Sutured Ghoul says, in part, “As this creature enters, exile any number of creature cards from your graveyard.” If Sutured Ghoul and Runeclaw Bear enter the battlefield from your graveyard at the same time, you can’t choose to exile either of them when applying Sutured Ghoul’s replacement effect.
